user_direction: Ending corporate announcement blames computer inventory mistake; five-cat reactions and Trixie returns to gaming. Opening broadcast unchanged. Explicit rally lead-in before dinner.

rows.speaker: Trixie
rows.text: Everyone, listen up. All five of us are here because this shortage affects every family in District Seven.

rows.speaker: TV
rows.text: Goodboy Global confirms that the salmon shortage was caused by a computer inventory mistake. The error has now been corrected.

rows.speaker: Onyx
rows.text: Bastards. They're taking credit for fixing their own scam.

rows.speaker: Neon
rows.text: Is everyone just going to keep lying down for these dogs?

rows.speaker: Ghost
rows.text: They changed the story. We still have the records.

rows.speaker: Trixie
rows.text: C'mon. Let's just play the game. We fixed it, even if no one knows it.
